snippet.title: Smiley Steel: Chapter 1 – The Experiment Begins | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
SMILEY STEEL – CHAPTER 1: THE EXPERIMENT BEGINS

Something is waiting beneath Nexora...

Enter the mysterious world of Smiley Steel, a first-person psychological mascot horror game where nothing is quite what it seems.

Explore the abandoned Nexora facility, solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets and discover what happened beneath the factory.

But be careful...

The experiment has only just begun.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Smiley Steel is currently in development. Content shown in this trailer is subject to change.

#SmileySteel #horrorgame #MascotHorror #IndieGame #GameDev
